BillHeading.Sponsors: House Consumer Protection & Business (originally sponsored by Representatives Walen, Ybarra, Springer, Simmons, Ramel, and Berg)
BillHeading.BriefDescription: Concerning consumer protection with respect to the sale of dogs and cats.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to consumer protection with respect to the sale of dogs and cats; and adding a new section to chapter 16.52 RCW.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. A new section is added to chapter 16.52 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: (1) Except as provided in this section, a retail pet store may not sell or offer for sale any dog or cat.
(2) A retail pet store that sold or offered for sale any dog prior to the effective date of this section may sell or offer for sale a dog.
